annotation.title_clean: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National AI Office (NAIO), Ministry of Digital, Malaysia
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian National AI Office consultation page (10 Jul–1 Aug 2026, pre-drafting) on a proposed AI Governance Bill creating a central AI authority, principle-based requirements and risk-based tiers. The page hosts the consultation papers and public comments on Sabah's constitutional position, EU interoperability, accountability gaps, children's protection and ESG. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposed Bill would establish central institutional AI oversight (Central AI Authority) with sectoral leads
Introduces principle-based national governance requirements and a three-tier risk-based framework
Contemplates an AI sandbox and incident-reporting mechanism
Commenters urge interoperability with the EU AI Act and ASEAN guides
Commenters raise Sabah/MA63 safeguards, independent oversight of the Authority, redress, and child protection
